info.title: Tong Panel current development API
info.description: Contract snapshot of implemented handlers in unmerged development drafts. This is not an approved production API or deployment. Only the loopback development daemon is configured below. Optional Server backends expose additional handler capabilities but are not enabled by this document. No password login, cookie/session issuance or rotation, MFA/recovery HTTP, privileged agent, host provisioning, certificate issuance, site deletion or database provisioning routes exist.

servers.description: Default IPv4-loopback development listener. TONG_DEV_LISTEN_ADDR may select another numeric IPv4 loopback address and port 1-65535. It serves no TLS; browser-session authentication and logout are not usable on this daemon configuration.

x-tong-contract-notes.stage: Preview contract; does not close P0/P1 acceptance or imply production support.
x-tong-contract-notes.authentication: A recognized session cookie takes precedence and is never downgraded to bearer. A nonempty Authorization header combined with the cookie is unauthorized. Cookie auth requires actual TLS, exactly one named cookie, active SQLite session/membership and, for mutation methods, one matching HTTPS Origin plus CSRF. Forwarded headers are not trusted. OpenAPI OR alternatives do not encode this precedence/conditional-origin policy.
x-tong-contract-notes.default-daemon: No Sessions, Files, FileQuota, FileMutationBarrier or SiteHostingPaths backend is configured. SiteCatalog/TXTLookup and SQLJobs require opt-in SQLite mode and existing identity/membership. Without configured credentials protected routes return auth_unconfigured before backend gates.
x-tong-contract-notes.authorization: Authenticated tenant context is server-derived; client tenant/user selectors do not elevate access. SQLJobs refreshes current membership before the handler; job mutations additionally recheck transactionally. No atomic role-revalidation guarantee is claimed for every site/Files mutation.
x-tong-contract-notes.json-parser: Canonical request property spelling is documented. Go encoding/json also accepts case-insensitive field matches and duplicate object members with its normal last-value behavior. DisallowUnknownFields rejects unknown fields; exactly one top-level JSON value is required. This contract does not claim duplicate JSON rejection.
x-tong-contract-notes.content-types: JSON and binary writes compare Content-Type strings exactly and reject parameters such as charset. x-max-request-bytes records byte caps, not JSON Schema character lengths.
x-tong-contract-notes.errors: x-error-codes lists per-response codes in addition to the shared Error schema. Message is the standard HTTP status text. Auth checks can fail before method/route/backend checks. Unknown paths and ServeMux canonical redirects can be native Go HTTP text/redirect responses, outside these declared operations.
x-tong-contract-notes.scope: Embedded UI/static assets are outside this control-plane contract. HEAD/OPTIONS/CORS methods are not added; API handlers generally reject unimplemented methods.

get.x-tong-backend-gate: JSON journal or SQLite job store.
get.description: SQLite returns only the active requester's own jobs; owner/admin are not cross-user exceptions. JSON-journal mode is tenant-scoped and has no requester attribution. A recognized limit or after query key opts into bounded ID-ascending pages. Paged requests allow only limit and after, each at most once; limit defaults to 50 and ranges from 1 to 100, while an explicitly supplied after must be 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The cursor is only a position, never authorization. next_after is the last returned ID only when more visible jobs exist, otherwise empty. Pages are live reads, not a frozen snapshot; newly inserted IDs before the cursor require a fresh traversal. No-query and unrelated-query-only legacy requests remain unbounded and return the original JobList shape. POST is unchanged.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Opts into paging. Decimal integer 1-100; default 50 when paging is selected by after alone. Each page parameter may occur once.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opts into paging and returns only visible IDs strictly after this position. Use the previous next_after; this does not grant access to the cursor owner. Omit for the first page; an explicit empty value is invalid.

requested_by.description: Present for SQLite jobs; omitted for JSON-journal jobs.

size.description: Regular-file size; other entry kinds report zero. Links are named, not followed.

Name.description: Normalized lowercase ASCII domain, without a final dot.

DocumentRoot.description: Tenant-relative sites/<SiteID>/public, generated by the server.

primary_domain.description: ASCII DNS name with at least two labels, no IP literal or Unicode; each label is 1â€“63 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens with no edge hyphen. A final dot and uppercase input are accepted and normalized.

items.description: ASCII DNS name with at least two labels, no IP literal or Unicode; each label is 1â€“63 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens with no edge hyphen. A final dot and uppercase input are accepted and normalized.

aliases.description: Optional aliases; no normalized duplicates or primary-domain duplicate. Null is treated as no aliases.

domain.description: ASCII DNS name with at least two labels, no IP literal or Unicode; each label is 1â€“63 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens with no edge hyphen. A final dot and uppercase input are accepted and normalized.

value.description: The exact value returned by beginDomainVerification, not a caller-selected DNS name.

Value.description: One-time proof value. Only its digest is persisted; do not log it.

ExpiresAt.description: Unix expiry in seconds, normally issue time + one hour. A new begin replaces the old proof.

next_after.description: Empty when no later row; otherwise the last returned site ID.

JobID.name: job_id
JobID.description: Server-issued job ID. Invalid shapes or unknown/inaccessible jobs are not disclosed.

schema.description: ASCII DNS name with at least two labels, no IP literal or Unicode; each label is 1â€“63 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens with no edge hyphen. A final dot and uppercase input are accepted and normalized.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 8â€“128 bytes in the implementation; use ASCII. Tenant-scoped. In SQLite mode it is also bound to the requester and kind. Identical retries return the same job (202); different work/requester conflicts (409).

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Required only for browser-cookie mutations: exactly one HTTPS Origin with no path/user/query/fragment, matching the actual Host including port (case-insensitive). Forwarded headers do not prove TLS/origin. OAS cannot express this credential-conditional requirement.

OptionalFilePath.name: path
OptionalFilePath.description: Tenant-relative directory; omitted or empty means the authenticated tenant root. No absolute path, traversal or tenant selector.

RequiredFilePath.name: path
RequiredFilePath.description: Tenant-relative file path selected inside the authenticated tenant root. No absolute path, traversal or following symlinks.

FileLimit.name: limit
FileLimit.description: Legacy listing: entry ceiling; 413 if exceeded. With page=1: maximum entries returned per page; scans at most 10000 directory names and fails rather than truncating.

RequestID.description: New 16-character lowercase hex request identifier; caller X-Request-ID is not used. It is not the independently generated audit request_id.

NoStore.description: This response must not be cached.

Allow.description: Methods supported by the route; present on most method-rejection responses.

ExpiredSession.description: Expires __Host-tong_session with Path=/, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Max-Age=0 and an expired Expires value. No new session is issued.

DevBearer.description: Development-only opaque static bearer token. Exact Bearer prefix; token check accepts 32â€“4096 bytes. This is not password login, OAuth or a production credential service.

BrowserSession.name: __Host-tong_session
BrowserSession.description: Separately issued opaque SQLite session. Requires actual TLS, no nonempty Authorization header and exactly one named cookie; current daemon does not configure Sessions/TLS. No route in this contract issues it.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Required with browser-session mutations, together with a single matching HTTPS Origin. Not required for development bearer requests. OpenAPI cannot prove origin equality or TLS transport.
